0022600156.text: The Clippers, who are 6th game of the season, come in at 1-4 with a 0-3 road record, a four-game losing streak, and a 13th-place spot in the West, 2.5 games behind for 4th in the Pacific. The Golden State Warriors are 3-3 on a three-game winning streak, 1 game back for 2nd in the Pacific and 10th in the West. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller, Max Strus, and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, while the Warriors are without Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody, and Stephen Curry. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Clippers won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 115-110 win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
